name: Beurre d’Escargot (Garlic-and-Herb “Escargot” Butter)

cookwares.name: food processor unless making by hand

ingredients.name: flat-leaf parsley leaves, from 1 small bunch

instructions.primary_message: In a food processor, pulse garlic, shallot, parsley leaves, salt, and a crack of black pepper until finely ground, about 10 to 15 pulses. (Do not overprocess; it should be finely ground but not a paste.)
Add butter and blend until well-combined, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to jar or airtight container and refrigerate.

schema_metadata.keywords: escargot butter, beurre d'escargot, escargot butter recipe, garlic butter recipe

description: This exceedingly simple garlic-and-herb butter comes together in minutes—and instantly upgrades vegetables, chicken, bread, pasta, and more.
notes:
Notes: To make escargot butter by hand, finely chop garlic, shallot, and parsley leaves. In a medium bowl, combine garlic, shallot, parsley, salt, and a crack of black pepper. Add cubed butter and, using a wooden spoon or flexible spatula, mix until well-combined. Refrigerate in an airtight container.

Make-ahead and storage: Escargot butter can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 14 days or frozen for up to 1 month. Thaw overnight in refrigerator before using.
author: Genevieve Yam
